thread:
Alice M.: quick triage update — CVE-2025-3344 affects grpc -> transitive dep. Impact: hosted + Dedicated + Private images. no active exploit reported but kernel of risk on public endpoints
Ben G.: timeline and customer impact? some Dedicated customers block outbound egress, so usual image delivery might fail
Alice M.: proposed patchflow: 1) hotpatch hosted ASAP 2) customer-scoped signed images for Dedicated/Private 3) backport to LTS branch for onprem installers. Keep RBAC changes gated.
Carol S.: +1. KMS question: does signing require cloud KMS rotation? we must support HSM/local key export for air-gapped customers 
Infra Bot: signing pipeline status: queued, first test image ETA ~4h. Note: for VPC-only customers we can push to their private registry or provide presigned S3 artifact.
Ben G.: RBAC audit change landed in same dependency bump — we should avoid rolling RBAC semantics in the same push. Gate with env var FEATURE_RBAC_V2=false by default for Dedicated.
Alice M.: agreed. add opt-in env + release note. keep old behaviour unless customer explicitly flips flag.
SRE OnCall: rollout requirements: canary on non-prod tenants, monitor auth_failure_rate and latency. rollback path: auto-fallback to prior image if error rate > 2% for 10m.
Security Eng: CVSS 6.1. Prioritization: P2 for general hosted; P1 for customers with public-facing endpoints or internet-exposed private deployments. Recommend immediate customer advisory for impacted set.
Carol S.: air-gapped customers: plan to ship a tarball + detached signature + verification instructions. Ensure signatures are compatible with local HSMs and don't assume cloud KMS API.
Ben G.: backport branches plan: release/2.2.x-patch (primary), release/2.1.x-compat (older installs). Build command snippet for reproducibility:
```
# example local image build and sign
scripts/mkimage --source=git@github.com:redwood/inference.git --ref=release/2.2.x-patch \
  --out=./artifacts/img-2025-175912.tar.gz --sign --signer=/keys/private.pem
```
Carol S.: I'll own customer outreach and advisory. ETA ~6h for initial advisory + remediation steps (RBAC flag, KMS config, upgrade path).
Infra Bot: smoke tests passed for test image. build id: img-2025-175912. signature: img-2025-175912.sig.
Ben G.: starting backport PRs to release/2.2.x-patch and release/2.1.x-compat. will tag PRs with "security/cve-2025-3344" and include test matrix for VPC/no-egress installs.
Carol S.: draft advisory here: https://docs.internal/redwood/advisories/cve-2025-3344 (WIP). will include steps for air-gap, pre-signed URL delivery, and opt-in RBAC flag.
SRE OnCall: add additional traces around auth path and increase log retention for next 7 days to help post-deploy triage.
Alice M.: I'll open the primary PRs and coordinate merges after Infra Bot confirms signed artifact. tagging owners: @Ben G., @Carol S., @Security Eng. :shipit:
Security Eng: also add CVE entry in tracker, include patched versions: 2.2.1, 2.1.8, and note mitigations for onprem.
Ben G.: noted. ping me when advisory is live and when artifacts are available for customer download.
Carol S.: will follow up with customers on the scheduled maintenance windows and provide offline install instructions.
Alice M.: thanks team. we'll mark this plan as active and close when PRs merged and advisory sent.
SRE OnCall: reminder: update runbook for emergency rollback and escalation contact list.
Alice M.: closing comment: Infra Bot confirmed builds, Ben starting PRs, Carol on customer comms. follow-ups in PR threads.
